description:
About the job

🌎 Location: Fully remote (LATAM or North America time zones, within 3 hours of Mexico City)




🏆 Strong communication skills in English




About Meaningful




Meaningful (M8L) is a growing and remote-first growth and product studio! We partner closely with early-stage and scaling startups, helping companies grow their visibility and revenue through SEO, content, Webflow, Framer, and go-to-market execution—without the overhead of traditional agencies.




About us: www.m8l.com




Our leadership brings serious Silicon Valley and LATAM experience:




CEO Orlando Osorio: Consulted for 100+ startups including unicorns like CloudKitchens and BetterUp, angel-backed by Michael Seibel (ex-CEO of Y Combinator)
CTO Alberto Sadde: Led engineering at AI-powered companies serving Fortune 100 clients, Oxford PhD dropout who chose to build in the startup world
Web & Growth Director Ana Alida Abdala (Ali): Scaled Konfío (Mexican unicorn) from 50 to 1,000+ employees, performance marketing expert with deep martech capabilities




We're intentionally small: a 45-person team of specialists who've worked with companies like Raycast, CloudKitchens, NameCheap, Klar, Platzi, SamCart, Kueski, Cashea, and Endeavor.




For every client, 1–2 directors are deeply involved to provide hands-on guidance and support.




We're deeply embedded in the tech ecosystem:




Official host of Growth Conference → growthconf.com
Continuous builders: supervisible.com, savedtask.com
Angel investors & LPs: 0bs, Nascent, 500, Rainforest
Mentors at Endeavor and 500 Startups




The Mission

We're looking for someone who lives in the data and can prove, not guess, what moves conversion. You'll own the experimentation roadmap for our clients: forming sharp hypotheses, designing rigorous tests, and reporting results, including the honest "inconclusive", with full statistical confidence. This is a skeptical, analytical role, not a design or copy role.


What You'll Own

Mine analytics and user research to find friction points worth testing
Write clear hypotheses and prioritize a live test backlog
Design experiments: define sample size, success metric, and test structure before launch
Analyze results for statistical significance and turn them into client-ready findings
Defend or kill a test on the numbers alone, live, in front of a sharp client
Train the broader team on CRO fundamentals, hypothesis writing, and how to read test data


What You'll Need

Strong, hands-on background in A/B testing, you've run tests in the past
Comfort with experiment design and statistics: significance, sample size, multi-variant judgment
Analytics depth (GA4, segmentation) and research tooling (heatmaps, session recordings)
Ability to set up tracking/QA so a test actually measures what it claims to measure
Professional English, you'll present findings directly to clients


Nice to Have

Background in paid/performance marketing
CRO certifications or structured training (e.g. CXL)
Familiarity with Webflow, Framer or similar platforms, enough to understand what's testable


What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited at least one client's analytics setup, shipped your first properly-powered test, and can walk a client through a result; win, loss, or inconclusive, leaning heavily on your quantitative and qualitative results.


Where We See This Person Coming From

Paid / performance marketer who lives close to data and understands significance instinctively
Data or web analyst with strong segmentation and reporting skills, ready to grow into hypothesis-driven work
Growth or product manager with a data-driven track record and genuine analytical curiosity

About the job

Description

We are looking for a Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager for the Amazon Mexico business to drive growth for the Amazon Mexico Stores via automated (performance) marketing channels.

We are looking for a marketing leader who likes to use technology to improve the customer experience and make a meaningful difference to how our customers shop online. At Amazon, we aim to become Earth’s most Customer-Centric Company and continue to innovate the way we engage with our customers through various marketing programs.

Critical missions of Paid Social and Creators team in Mexico are 1) to drive traffic and create innovative marketing programs in existing channels to make Amazon the most preferred shopping and entertainment destination for customers in Mexico, 2) to provide the best-in-class customer experience with highly personalized engaging marketing programs to help our customers make purchasing decisions, 3) to educate and attract new customers to Amazon overall and specific offerings, and 4) to dive deep into data to gain insights and optimize marketing programs.

The Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager plays a critical role in realizing these missions, leading various online marketing functions for Amazon.com.mx, managing and improving the marketing programs in Social Media Advertising and Creators Marketing. They will also be responsible for driving innovation by owning internally developed automated marketing products and platforms by leveraging the Amazon’s technologies. This position is one of the key senior roles in the Mexico Marketing and Prime organization. The impact of this role is significant, accounting for a large percentage of all amazon.com.mx new customers, traffic and sales. The position reports to the Head of Automated Marketing for Amazon Mexico.

description:
About the job

Life tastes better with ice cream 

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

Mordisko Brand Lead

Ubicación

México, Tultitlán, Híbrido

Tipo de Contrato

Permanente

Línea de reporte

OOH & Multipacks Manager

Propósito del Rol

Como Mordisko Brand Lead, serás responsable de liderar la estrategia, gestión y crecimiento de una de las marcas más relevantes del portafolio de Helados Holanda, Mordisko, además de contribuir al fortalecimiento y desarrollo de otras marcas del segmento de impulso. Tu rol requerirá desarrollar un profundo entendimiento del consumidor, el mercado y las tendencias de la categoría para diseñar e implementar estrategias efectivas que impulsen el crecimiento de las marcas.

Serás responsable de la ejecución de la marca en el corto plazo, apalancado del análisis y diagnóstico estratégico orientado a resultados, identificando oportunidades y desafíos de manera oportuna. Asimismo, liderarás proyectos de corto y mediano plazo en colaboración con equipos multifuncionales, promoviendo una cultura de innovación, agilidad y excelencia que permita construir marcas sólidas, relevantes y cercanas a los consumidores.

Buscamos una persona apasionada por el marketing y la construcción de marcas, con capacidad para tomar decisiones basadas en datos, iniciativa para impulsar nuevas oportunidades, creatividad para resolver desafíos de negocio, mentalidad emprendedora y excelentes habilidades de comunicación e influencia para trabajar de manera efectiva con diferentes áreas y niveles de la organización.

Responsabilidades clave

Estrategia de marca y crecimiento: Desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias integrales de marca y crecimiento que se alineen con los objetivos generales de TMICC.


Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para alinear las estrategias de portafolio, canales y comunicación. 
Identificar oportunidades de expansión y diferenciación en el mercado. 
Definir oportunidades de crecimiento de la marca y ejecutar planes para capitalizarlas. 
Responsable de la administración presupuestal de la inversión en marketing para sus marcas. 


Posicionamiento y comunicación de marca: Liderar la agenda de construcción de marca para lograr los objetivos y desarrollar mensajes y campañas que comuniquen de manera efectiva la propuesta de valor de las marcas a su cargo. De igual forma, participar en la adaptación y ejecución de estrategias de marca a los diferentes canales y realidades geográficas.

Experiencia de marca: Crear relaciones sólidas con los consumidores a través de experiencias y activaciones de marca atractivas. Desarrollar e implementar iniciativas para fomentar la lealtad y relevancia.

Planes de ejecución: Colaborar con áreas comerciales para desarrollar planes de ejecución de nuevos productos e iniciativas, garantizando la ejecución perfecta en todos los canales y puntos de contacto con el consumidor.

Medición y optimización: Dar trazabilidad de indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para realizar un seguimiento del éxito de las iniciativas de marca y hacer recomendaciones basadas en datos:


Desarrollo de diagnósticos del desempeño de las marcas bajo su responsabilidad. 
Identificar oportunidades y/o planes de acción y mejora, basado en hechos y datos. 
Recopilación de información relevante y análisis de datos de mercado para identificar problemas y oportunidades que impulsen decisiones críticas. 


Habilidades y Experiencia

Habilidades Core


Fuertes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas. 
Análisis de información cuantitativa y cualitativa: capacidad para conectar insights, data y tendencias con oportunidades claras de crecimiento. 
Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno de equipo de ritmo rápido con cronogramas de proyectos exigentes. 
Liderazgo transversal: capacidad para influir en pares y coordinar equipos multifuncionales. 
Alta atención al detalle. 
Habilidad para trabajo en equipo. 
Proactividad. 
Orden y seguimiento.

Licenciatura en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Economía o disciplinas afines 
Dominio del inglés (oral y escrito). 
+4 años de experiencia en roles de marketing, deseable en Consumo Masivo (FMCG). 
Experiencia superior a 3 años en el desarrollo de campañas de comunicación y desarrollo de marcas. 
Dominio de herramientas de análisis y gestión (ej. Nielsen, Kantar, Power BI, Excel).

Compensación competitiva y esquema de incentivos basado en desempeño. 
Apoyo en salud y bienestar. 
Oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo. 


#TMICC

Why join us? 

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.


 Roles with real accountability and visible impact
 Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
 Continuous learning and development as the business grows
 Reward linked to performance and contribution.


Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

Ready to build the future of Ice Cream? 

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

Additional Information

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We encourage people with all backgrounds to apply including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, and Māori and Pacific Peoples.

Lead the design and build of landing pages and websites for growth marketing clients

Partner directly with the client to shape or sharpen their positioning and value prop when it isn't already clear, most clients don't walk in with this solved

Own client reviews and presentations for creative work
Use data directionally: you ask "did this work?" but aren't necessarily running formal statistical tests

Professional English, you'll present work directly to clients

Basic GA4 fluency and an intuitive sense for what drives conversion
Agency or client-services experience managing scope and timelines

In your first 90 days, you've led at least one landing page or site through design and build, kept the designer and developer aligned on a shared bar of quality, and had a client tell you the result looks and reads great.

Designer with a strong messaging instinct, ready to own the client and the project

Role summary

The Consumer & Retail Performance Lead owns performance interpretation for the consumer and retail/eTail motion. This role turns demand and conversion signals into early, credible insight so leadership can identify drift, understand implications, and take action before issues become material.

This person will build a repeatable view of retail performance health, detect emerging deviations, and frame them clearly for decision-making. The role is intentionally bounded: it does not own media buying, campaign execution, or retail partnership management. Its mandate is to provide trustworthy interpretation and escalation based on available signals and stated confidence.

description:
About the job

Marketing Recruiter (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary: $800 to $1,200 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.




You should genuinely enjoy talking to people, evaluating talent, improving recruiting systems, and building relationships with candidates. You care about quality over quantity and believe that hiring one outstanding person beats hiring 10 average ones.




As our company grows, you'll also help improve our recruiting systems, employer branding, onboarding experience, company culture and talent pipelines so hiring becomes faster, smarter, and more scalable.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Present hiring managers with highly qualified candidates instead of large numbers of average applicants.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.
Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.
Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.
Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.
Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.
Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.
Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.
Partner closely with leadership to understand hiring priorities and proactively recommend improvements.




What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.
Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.
Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.
Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.
Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.
Conduct structured interviews.
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
Perform reference checks when appropriate.
Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.
Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.




2) Candidate Evaluation

Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.
Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.
Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.
Build structured interview scorecards for every role.
Develop role-specific interview questions.
Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.




3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

Build and improve recruiting workflows.
Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.
Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.
Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.
Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.
Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.




4) Partnership With Leadership

Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.
Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.
Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.
Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.
Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.




5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.
Write engaging candidate outreach messages.
Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.
Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.




6) Onboarding Support

Coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires.
Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.
Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.




7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional Projects

When recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

Supporting HR and administrative tasks when needed.
Helping organize company documents, processes, and SOPs.
Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.
Helping with company culture, team engagement, and employee experience initiatives.
Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.




This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.




What We're Looking For

Preferred:

Experience recruiting for roles such as:
E-commerce Shopify DTC Marketing
Paid Media
Creative Strategy
Video Editing
Email Marketing
SMS Marketing
Affiliate Marketing
Influencer Marketing
Wholesale Sales

Experience working with remote international teams is a strong plus.




Must-haves:

2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.
Experience recruiting digital marketing, creative, e-commerce, or startup positions.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.
Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.
Exceptional organization and follow-through.
Strong ownership mindset, you proactively solve problems instead of waiting for direction.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Must have a growth mindset, developing your skills and solving hardest problems. 




Nice to have:

LinkedIn Recruiter
Indeed
OnlineJobs.ph
Google Workspace
Asana
AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
Startup or e-commerce experience
Experience building recruiting scorecards, interview guides, assessments, or hiring SOPs




What You Get:

$800 to $1,200 USD per month plus performance bonuses based on experience.
Fully remote role with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern.
Direct collaboration with leadership and the Founder.
Significant opportunities for career growth as TopFoxx continues to scale.
A supportive, ambitious, and collaborative team environment.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off.




How to Apply:

Send us your resume to recruiting@topfoxx.com along with a short response answering the following question: Tell us about the most difficult role you've ever recruited for. What made it challenging, how did you approach the search, and what was the final outcome?




We'd also love to know why recruiting marketing and creative talent excites you, and what you think separates an exceptional candidate from an average one.




If you're passionate about building outstanding teams and helping a growing company find incredible people, we'd love to hear from you.

At Adyen, our sales teams take initiatives, allowing them to make an impact from day one and we highly encourage working as a team because winning is more important than ego. Adyen is the place where sales mavericks can take flight.

Ready to meet us?

If you are excited about this role, apply by clicking the link below. We can’t wait to meet you!

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. About the job

Sobre Kolors

Kolors es un ecosistema de movilidad corporativa y de traslado diario que aprovecha la tecnología, la optimización basada en datos y una obsesión por ofrecer la mejor experiencia al pasajero, con el objetivo de hacer los traslados cotidianos más eficientes, convenientes, seguros y cómodos. Operamos bajo un modelo B2B de transporte corporativo respaldado por una plataforma tecnológica propia, con enfoque en crecimiento rentable y excelencia operativa.




Acerca del empleo

El Customer Success Manager (CSM)  (retention and growth of key enterprise accounts), es responsable del éxito integral del cliente a lo largo del ciclo de vida del contrato. Su misión es asegurar que cada cuenta obtenga el valor esperado del servicio, mantenga una relación sólida con la compañía y genere crecimiento sostenible en ingresos. 

Actúa como líder estratégico de la cuenta y principal punto de contacto ejecutivo.

Esta posición no corresponde a un rol de Customer Experience en un modelo B2C, ni implica funciones de atención tipo call center. Dentro del ciclo completo de ventas (end-to-end), esta posición no se enfoca en la prospección ni en el cierre de nuevos clientes, sino en la retención y el crecimiento de la base de clientes enterprise actuales.

Esta posición reporta al Head of Customer Success.




Responsabilidades principales

1. Gestión estratégica de cuentas clave

Entender el modelo de negocio, objetivos y prioridades del cliente.
Monitorear indicadores de salud (Health Score).
Detectar riesgos de churn y liderar planes de mitigación.
Conocimiento de licitaciones de clientes.
Manejo de clientes con categoría AAA.

2. Relación ejecutiva

Liderar reuniones ejecutivas (QBRs / MBRs).
Comunicar resultados, avances y oportunidades de mejora.

3. Retención y crecimiento

Liderar procesos de renovación contractual de sus cuentas.
Identificar oportunidades de upsell y cross-sell.
Maximizar Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

4. Coordinación interna

Orquestar equipos internos (Operaciones, Producto, Soporte, Salesl).
Priorizar iniciativas según impacto en el cliente.

5. Gestión de riesgos y escalaciones

Gestionar situaciones críticas que impacten la relación.

En Kolors nos esforzamos por construir una fuerza laboral compuesta por personas con diversos antecedentes, habilidades, mentes e identidades que nos ayuden a crecer, no sólo como empresa, sino también como individuos. title: Growth Engineer o Head of Growth
description:
About the job

Sobre el puesto:




En buscamos un Head of Growth / Growth Engineer con alto perfil técnico y analítico, enfocado en diseñar, implementar y escalar estrategias de adquisición masiva, retención y monetización para plataformas digitales con modelo de suscripción recurrente (Freemium, Free Trial y conversión a pago).




Buscamos a alguien con mentalidad científica, obsesionado con los datos, la experimentación continua y la automatización de flujos de crecimiento dentro del producto.




Responsabilidades Principales:

- Diseñar e implementar Growth Loops (mecanismos de viralidad, retención de cohortes y conversión estratégica).

- Optimizar el Onboarding y el Time-to-Value (TTV) para maximizar la tasa de conversión Free-to-Paid.

- Instrumentar eventos y analítica de producto avanzada (Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, Segment o herramientas afines).

- Diseñar, ejecutar y analizar experimentos A/B rigurosos en funnels de registro, paywalls, esquemas de precios y activación de usuarios.

- Definir e implementar estrategias para reducir el Churn y maximizar la retención (Net Revenue Retention > 100%).

- Conectar e integrar pipelines de datos, webhooks y automatizaciones con la arquitectura técnica del producto.




Requisitos y Competencias Técnicas:

- Experiencia demostrable escalando plataformas digitales con modelo de suscripción masiva (B2C o B2B PLG).

- Dominio de analítica de producto, segmentación por comportamientos y métricas de retención por cohortes.

- Background técnico o capacidad para interactuar directamente con APIs, scripts, bases de datos y herramientas de experimentación.

- Dominio comprobado de métricas clave de crecimiento: LTV, CAC, MRR/ARR, Free-to-Paid Conversion Rate y Retention Rate.




¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?

Formarás parte de un equipo enfocado en la innovación tecnológica y el crecimiento exponencial, diseñando sistemas de escala directa para productos digitales.

title: Guaraní Language Expert - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
About the job

Are you a Guaraní language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Guaraní vocabulary, grammar, dialectical variations, and cultural context—helping preserve indigenous knowledge and support authentic linguistic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Guaraní language specialists who live and breathe regional dialects, phonetics, syntax, idiomatic expressions, oral traditions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, tone and meaning, dialectical distinctions, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Guaraní across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A Master's degree in Linguistics, Indigenous Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Guaraní expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

description:
About the job

About the job




🌎 Location: Fully remote (LATAM or North America time zones, within 3 hours of Mexico City)




🏆 Strong communication skills in English




About Meaningful




Meaningful (M8L) is a growing and remote-first growth and product studio! We partner closely with early-stage and scaling startups, helping companies grow their visibility and revenue through SEO, content, Webflow, Framer, and go-to-market execution—without the overhead of traditional agencies.




About us: www.m8l.com




Our leadership brings serious Silicon Valley and LATAM experience:




CEO Orlando Osorio: Consulted for 100+ startups including unicorns like CloudKitchens and BetterUp, angel-backed by Michael Seibel (ex-CEO of Y Combinator)
CTO Alberto Sadde: Led engineering at AI-powered companies serving Fortune 100 clients, Oxford PhD dropout who chose to build in the startup world
Web & Growth Director Ana Alida Abdala (Ali): Scaled Konfío (Mexican unicorn) from 50 to 1,000+ employees, performance marketing expert with deep martech capabilities




We're intentionally small: a 45-person team of specialists who've worked with companies like Raycast, CloudKitchens, NameCheap, Klar, Platzi, SamCart, Kueski, Cashea, and Endeavor.




For every client, 1–2 directors are deeply involved to provide hands-on guidance and support.




We're deeply embedded in the tech ecosystem:




Official host of Growth Conference → growthconf.com
Continuous builders: supervisible.com, savedtask.com
Angel investors & LPs: 0bs, Nascent, 500, Rainforest
Mentors at Endeavor and 500 Startups







We're looking for a Video Content Creator who can own video content end-to-end, from the first idea to the final export. This isn't a pure editing role: you'll come up with concepts, write scripts and hooks, and then bring them to life in the edit. Most of what you'll make is short-form (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) for clients across LATAM and the US, with real opportunity to grow into long-form work like podcasts and YouTube.

You won't be handed a folder of footage and a brief every time. Often you'll be the one deciding what the video should even be, the concept, the hook, the structure, before a single clip gets cut.




What you'll do

Ideate. Come up with content concepts tailored to each client's brand, audience, and the platform it's going on, not generic templates.

Script. Write scripts, hooks, and shot lists that are built for retention, not just information.

Edit. Turn raw footage, client-recorded or your own, into polished, platform-native content.

Guide recording. For most clients, you won't be on camera yourself. You'll write clear shot lists and prompts so clients can record themselves well, and coach them on what "good raw footage" looks like.

Occasionally record. For a handful of clients, you may record voiceover or on-camera segments yourself when it's the right fit.

Stay current. Keep a pulse on short-form trends, formats, and platform changes, and bring new ideas to the team proactively.




What we're looking for
A portfolio that shows range across the full process, concept, script, and edit, not just clean cuts on someone else's footage.
Strong instincts for what makes short-form content get watched to the end: hooks, pacing, retention.
Excellent written English. Scripts need to land with US audiences even when you're not the one on camera.
Comfortable in standard editing tools (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar). Motion graphics skills are a plus, not a requirement.
Experience creating your own content, a personal channel, TikTok, or Instagram presence, is a strong signal, even if it's small.
Bonus: experience recording your own voiceover or on-camera content, podcast production experience, or bilingual (Spanish/English) fluency.




What's different about this role vs. a typical editor job

This role is built around judgment as much as execution. We're not looking for someone who can just "cut well", we want someone who understands why one hook works better than another, who can defend a creative choice with a result, and who's excited to own that thinking instead of waiting to be told what to make.

title: Arabic (Gulf) Language Expert - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
About the job

Are you an Arabic (Gulf) language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural understanding. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Gulf Arabic vocabulary, dialects, grammar, idiomatic expressions, and cultural context—helping preserve linguistic heritage and support authentic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Arabic (Gulf) language specialists who live and breathe phonetics, morphology, syntax, regional dialects, colloquial expressions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, dialectical distinctions, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Gulf Arabic across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A Master's degree in Linguistics, Middle Eastern Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Arabic (Gulf) expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.

Bachelor's degree.

Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).

About the job

Una de las decisiones más emocionantes y significativas en la vida es elegir dónde vas a vivir. Por eso creamos EasyBroker: para darle a los asesores inmobiliarios las herramientas que necesitan para prosperar y ofrecer un servicio excepcional, haciendo que comprar o rentar sea simple y sin estrés. Hoy apoyamos a más de 15,000 profesionales, con más de 500,000 propiedades y más de 3,000 sitios web creados con nuestra plataforma.

Aunque empezamos en 2007, trabajamos como una startup: equipo pequeño, remoto, muy talentoso y con un enfoque radical en crear productos que importan. Valoramos el criterio, el buen gusto, la autonomía y la capacidad de llevar proyectos de principio a fin. Aquí no eres una pieza más: das forma a las ideas, hablas con usuarios cuando hace falta, propones soluciones y tienes un impacto real en el producto y en el negocio.

Ahora estamos apostando fuerte por Pincali, nuestro nuevo marketplace con el que queremos convertirnos en el mejor lugar para comprar o rentar tu hogar en México. Es un proyecto ambicioso diseñado para crecer rápido: nuestra meta es multiplicar por diez los ingresos en tres años. Y, a diferencia de muchas startups, tenemos algo que prácticamente nadie más tiene:


17 años de experiencia profunda en el sector.

Eso nos coloca en una posición extraordinaria: tenemos una probabilidad muy alta de que Pincali sea un éxito masivo. Y quienes se unan ahora tendrán la oportunidad de crecer junto con el proyecto y beneficiarse directamente del impacto que generen. Es una de esas ventanas únicas donde el riesgo es bajo y el potencial es extremadamente alto.

Si te inspira la idea de construir algo grande, asumir verdadera responsabilidad y trabajar con gente talentosa en un producto con enorme potencial, aquí puedes hacer el mejor trabajo de tu carrera. Queremos que quienes se unan ahora crezcan tanto como la empresa y que se beneficien de manera importante del éxito que estamos construyendo juntos.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión?

EasyBroker llegó hasta donde está en gran medida porque los agentes inmobiliarios se lo recomiendan entre sí. Detrás de eso hay un equipo que conoce de cerca el reto de ser agente inmobiliario en México: sus presiones, su forma de trabajar y lo que necesitan para hacer crecer su negocio. About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Customer Success Operations & Enablement

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Customer Success Sr. Specialist for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:


 Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors
 Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products
 Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them



Growing The Business:


 Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products
 Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings
 Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data



Technical & Program Readiness:


 Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition
 Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products



All About You:


 Experience managing clients or internal stakeholders
 Logical, structured thinking, and affinity for numerical analysis
 Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
 Undergraduate degree with work experience in consulting, corporate strategy, business intelligence, business line management, or product management
 Experienced at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage
 Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus
 Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability
 Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth
 Experience in identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties
 Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges
 Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level
 Experience working with at least some of the following: large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners



Spanish and fluent English (advanced Portuguese highly desirable)

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Strong customer‑service orientation with a focus on building trust, partnership, and positive user experiences.

Advanced problem‑solving skills with the ability to analyze root causes and proactively identify solutions.
Proven ability to manage multiple requests and priorities in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment.

About the job

Description

At Amazon, we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We believe that every day is an opportunity to take a first step, tackle new challenges, and make our customers’ lives easier. And today, that opportunity is yours!

As a Learning Manager at Amazon, you will play a vital role in developing and managing a team of trainers responsible for delivering high-quality learning experiences to our associates and managers. Working closely with Process Engineers, you will collaborate with Operations teams to ensure our training programs meet customer needs and align with our mission to be Earth’s most customer-centric company.

You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and challenging environment, with many opportunities to make an impact. Whether you are developing training plans, auditing training quality, or planning and executing the recruitment of new instructors, you will be at the forefront of shaping the future of our organization.

To get an idea of what it is like to work in an Amazon Fulfillment Center, watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cozvNg-a5EI

 Plan and execute the recruitment, selection, and development of top-performing trainers.
 Foster positive and effective collaboration between the Learning team and key stakeholders.

 Analyze and interpret metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
 Deliver training to the Learning team regarding updates to learning materials and processes.
 Develop training capacity plans and forecasting for new hires.
 Support leadership teams by providing reports related to Associate (AA) allocation based on training status and cross-training plans across processes.
 Experience designing and implementing training strategies, policies, and procedures to standardize and deliver training methodologies across an organization.
 Experience managing training KPIs and planning and coordinating training programs for more than 1,000 employees.
 Experience interacting with Learning Management Systems (LMS).

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

 1+ years of program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or related field experience
 Experience collaborating with global and local stakeholders
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English

 2+ years of relevant field experience

description:
About the job

Description

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join the Amazon Payments Mexico marketing team. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of marketing execution for one or more payment products within the Amazon Mexico ecosystem. You will be responsible for converting marketing strategy into customer-facing outcomes through hands-on, week-by-week execution across onsite merchandising, promotions, performance reporting, and competitive intelligence.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity role where you will manage the full execution lifecycle — from campaign creation and promotional configuration to post-campaign analysis — operating within Amazon's rigorous weekly business review cadence.

Key job responsibilities

Onsite Merchandising

Own all customer-facing placements on Amazon.com.mx including Maple campaigns (High Upsell Cards, Mobile View Cards, Priceblock banners, Wallet placements), DPIC content, Sparkle keyword campaigns, homepage hero banners, and landing pages

Manage creative briefing, review, scheduling coordination, and multi-channel QA across mobile, app, and desktop

Execute large-scale campaign rotations during High-Velocity Events (40+ onsite campaigns and 5–8 landing pages per event)

Configure targeting by card issuer and customer segment

Promotions & Discounts

Design promotional strategies for assigned payment products and navigate approval workflows with Finance and Legal

Configure promotions in relevant systems (PAWS, IBD coupon architecture, cashback configurations)

Coordinate with up to 14 issuing bank partners on offer structures, communication timing, and shared funding

Maintain a rolling pipeline of promotions planned quarters ahead and deliver post-promotion ROI reporting

Monitoring & Reporting

Produce weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR data pulls, and monthly deep-dive analyses

Maintain dashboards, detect anomalies, and deliver post-campaign performance reports and QBR inputs

Provide the feedback loop that determines campaign effectiveness, segment conversion, and budget efficiency

Competitive Intelligence

Conduct monthly structured competitive scans covering MercadoLibre, Liverpool, Coppel, major issuing banks, and emerging fintechs

Track feature launches, promotional mechanics, pricing changes, onsite merchandising tactics, and media spend shifts

Deliver intel summaries to the broader team and product partners

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

Write campaign briefs, BRDs, 1-pagers, and post-mortem narratives

Participate in weekly syncs with product managers, agency partners, legal/compliance reviews, and team ceremonies

Operate within Amazon's written communication culture and weekly business review cadence

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English
 3+ years of stakeholder management experience
 +8 YOE using data and metrics to drive improvements


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
About the job

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




Technical Growth Marketing Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll take ownership of modernizing and scaling the marketing engine, delivering leads today while laying the foundation for AI-driven, personalized systems that define the next phase of growth. Embedded directly within the marketing team, you'll manage the balance between short-term lead delivery and long-term system building, working closely with growth, marketing ops, and engineering resources to align technical execution with marketing goals. This is your opportunity to bring structure and technical depth to a marketing function reaching a hard-to-reach SMB market, owning outcomes across inbound, de-anonymization, and personalized outbound.




What You'll Do:




- Own the modernization and scaling of the marketing engine, balancing short-term lead delivery with long-term AI-driven system building.

- Manage and optimize inbound marketing performance to improve lead quality and volume.

- Oversee website de-anonymization initiatives to identify and act on anonymous traffic.

- Direct personalized outbound strategies enriched specifically for a hard-to-reach SMB market.

- Serve as an embedded extension of the marketing team, aligning growth, marketing ops, and engineering around shared goals.




What we are looking for:




- Background combining business and marketing fundamentals with enough technical fluency to manage AI-driven systems, similar to an industrial engineer with marketing training and coding exposure.

- Experience or strong interest in GenAI applied to growth marketing.

- Ownership mindset with the ability to manage both short-term lead delivery and long-term system building.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

Hoy estamos presentes en 10 países y desarrollamos soluciones digitales que ayudan a miles de profesionales sanitarios a potenciar su actividad y a millones de personas a encontrar la atención sanitaria que necesitan.

Creemos que la tecnología genera un mayor impacto cuando se pone al servicio de las personas. Por eso seguimos creciendo y buscando talento que quiera ayudarnos a construir el futuro de la salud digital en un entorno internacional, innovador y en constante evolución.

Porque tendrás un impacto directo en el crecimiento de Top Doctors en Latinoamérica. Como Performance Marketing Specialist, liderarás la estrategia de captación digital de pacientes, médicos y centros médicos, siendo responsable de generar oportunidades de negocio a través de campañas de paid media orientadas a resultados.

Tendrás ownership sobre todo el ciclo de las campañas: desde la definición de la estrategia y la gestión de presupuestos hasta la optimización continua y el análisis de resultados. Trabajarás de forma muy cercana con los equipos de Ventas, Marketing y Revenue para asegurar que los leads generados se conviertan en crecimiento real para el negocio.

Tu trabajo tendrá una influencia directa en métricas clave como la generación de leads, el coste de adquisición, la calidad del pipeline comercial y el retorno de la inversión publicitaria, contribuyendo al crecimiento de una de las compañías HealthTech líderes en Latinoamérica.

Planear, implementar y optimizar campañas de paid media en Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) y redes de afiliados.
Liderar la captación digital de los tres segmentos clave: pacientes, médicos/especialistas y centros médicos o clínicas.

Si Disfrutas Tomando Decisiones Basadas En Datos, Optimizando Campañas Con Impacto Real En El Negocio y Trabajando En Entornos Donde Marketing y Revenue Están Estrechamente Conectados, Probablemente Encajarás Muy Bien En Este Rol Si Tienes

description:
About the job

¿Tu sueldo actual no compensa las horas que le das a tu trabajo?

Si sientes que trabajas tiempo completo pero vives con la cabeza en otro lado —pensando en lo que no estás cobrando, en el tiempo que no estás recuperando, en la vida personal que sigue esperando— esta vacante es para ti.

No te pedimos que renuncies hoy. Te proponemos algo distinto: pruébalo primero.

Descripción del puesto

Como Asociado Agente de Seguros Online en APERFÍN Apertura Financiera, socio comercial de AXA Seguros, asesorarás a personas interesadas en contratar seguros a través de canales digitales (teléfono, videollamada, chat y correo electrónico).

Tu día a día incluirá analizar las necesidades de cada persona, presentar opciones de seguros adecuadas, elaborar propuestas y acompañar el cierre de la contratación de manera 100% online. También darás seguimiento a tu cartera de clientes, resolverás dudas postventa y colaborarás en la identificación de nuevas oportunidades comerciales. Participarás en sesiones de formación continua sobre productos, herramientas digitales y normativa del sector asegurador.

Esta posición está diseñada como una puerta de entrada flexible, pensada tanto para quien busca su próximo paso profesional como para quien hoy tiene un empleo de tiempo completo pero no encuentra en él la compensación ni el equilibrio que busca.

Así funciona el modelo:

Inicias en modalidad de medio tiempo, compatible con tu trabajo actual si lo tienes. Durante los primeros 90 días recibirás capacitación estructurada, acompañamiento personalizado y una metodología de trabajo probada —sin improvisación, paso a paso— para construir tu cartera de clientes desde cero.

El reto es simple de entender y honesto de plantear: que al cierre de esos 90 días, tu actividad como asesor de seguros esté generando un ingreso comparable al que hoy percibes en tu empleo de tiempo completo. Si lo logras, el siguiente paso es tuyo: dedicarte por completo a esta carrera, con el control de tu tiempo y tu crecimiento en tus propias manos.

Es un modelo remoto, lo que te permite trabajar desde cualquier ubicación con buena conexión a internet, y organizar tus horas alrededor de tu vida —no al revés.

Requisitos

Tener residencia permanente dentro de la República Mexicana.
Aptitudes sólidas de comunicación y habilidades para la escritura clara y persuasiva en entornos digitales.
Capacidad analítica para interpretar necesidades de seguros, realizar comparativas de productos y apoyar la toma de decisiones de la persona cliente.
Experiencia en investigación y búsqueda de información para mantenerte actualizado sobre productos, condiciones y tendencias del mercado asegurador.
Interés y capacidad para la formación continua, tanto para aprender como para compartir conocimiento con el equipo.
Manejo fluido de herramientas ofimáticas, CRM y plataformas de comunicación online (videollamadas, chat, correo).
Orientación a resultados, organización del tiempo en entorno remoto y enfoque claro al servicio de la persona cliente.
Disponibilidad de medio tiempo para iniciar, con apertura a escalar a tiempo completo conforme tu cartera crece.
Se valorará experiencia previa en seguros, banca, ventas online o atención al cliente, así como conocimientos básicos de productos de AXA Seguros.

¿Para quién es esta vacante?

Para quien busca activamente su próximo empleo y quiere construir algo propio, no solo ocupar una posición.

Para quien hoy tiene trabajo de tiempo completo, pero siente que el sueldo no corresponde al esfuerzo, que no hay margen para crecer, o que la vida personal quedó relegada a los fines de semana.

Para quien está dispuesto a invertir 90 días de disciplina y aprendizaje a cambio de la posibilidad real de diseñar su propio horario, su propio techo de ingreso y su propio equilibrio.

Postúlate. La primera conversación no te compromete a nada, solo te da información para decidir con claridad.

title: K'iche' (Mayan) Language Expert - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
About the job

Are you a K'iche' language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture K'iche' vocabulary, grammar, dialectical variations, and cultural context—helping preserve Mayan knowledge and support authentic linguistic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for K'iche' language specialists who live and breathe regional dialects, phonetics, syntax, idiomatic expressions, oral traditions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, tone and meaning, dialectical distinctions, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model in K'iche' across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A Master's degree in Linguistics, Indigenous Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your K'iche' expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

The Amazon Digital and Emerging Payments Team’s vision is to delight our customers with the best payment experience in the world! To achieve this vision, we are in search of a talented Software Developer who is customer obsessed and is focused on delivering first class quality products to our customers.

Our team takes a world view of payments for all of Amazon and builds highly customized and seamless payment experiences for our global customers. This focuses on geography and customer requires working on different technologies such as Android, Amazon Fire, and back-end platform systems in order to meet the needs of our customers. Our back-end systems are always available and guarantee that our customers' orders are never lost and always processed even when downstream services are down.

We are looking for a software development Engineer to play a key role in the Digital Payments & Emerging Markets (DEP) team, primarily building Amazon's Mexico Payments Products. This role offers exciting challenges and the opportunity to influence and drive a growing payments area.

title: Small Business Ownership or Manager – Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
About the job

Are you a current small business owner or manager eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of supporting entrepreneurs with operations, strategy, financial planning, and customer engagement. With high-quality training data grounded in real-world business experience, tomorrow’s AI can better serve Small Business owners and managers navigating limited resources and high-stakes decisions. That training data begins with you—we need your practical expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for current owners, co-owners, and managers across a range of industries, including retail, e-commerce, professional services such as consulting, legal, and accounting, technology and software, hospitality and food and beverage, healthcare and wellness, creative and media, construction and trades, and other small business sectors. Whether you are a new business owner or have years of operational experience, your insight into day-to-day decision-making is highly valuable.

On a typical day, you will engage the model with realistic small business scenarios and operational challenges; evaluate outputs related to budgeting, pricing, marketing strategy, hiring decisions, vendor management, customer communications, and basic compliance considerations; assess whether responses are practical and aligned with how Very Small Businesses actually operate; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation criteria, and real-world applicability. You may also help identify where models oversimplify trade-offs or misunderstand resource constraints common to VSB environments.

Direct experience owning or co-owning a small business is strongly preferred. Experience managing operations, finances, marketing, staffing, or growth strategy is highly relevant. Entry-level business owners as well as seasoned entrepreneurs are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating how and why decisions are made in a real business context—is essential.

Ready to turn your small business ownership experience into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that better support entrepreneurs worldwide.

We offer a pay range of $20 to $100 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Workplace type: Remote

Seniority level: Entry Level
