description:
About the job

Paid Media Video Editor (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook)

Remote | Full-time or Part time | Fluent English Required

Time: 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (Hours are flexible, we care about performance not clocks).

Salary: $800 - $1,500 USD/month based on experience + performance bonuses




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a woman-owned sunglasses brand designed in NYC. We don't make glasses that just look good, we make glasses that solve problems. Our tangle-free aviators, floating sunglasses, foldable shades, UV400 lenses, and shatter-resistant designs are built for real people. We're a small, remote team, which means we move fast and every person we bring on has a real impact.




We are growing. That growth is driven by performance creative ads that convert, content that earns attention, and a team that understands the difference between looking good and actually selling.




Our biggest opportunity right now is creative execution: producing high-volume, high-quality video content that captures attention and drives revenue. We already have a growing library of UGC, influencer content, product footage, and internal creative assets. What we need is someone who can turn those assets into ads that make people stop scrolling, understand why they need the product, and click “Buy.” 




The Role

We are looking for a Paid Media Video Editor to join our growing marketing team. This is not a traditional video editing role.




You will not simply take footage and make it look polished. This is a performance creative role where video editing is the primary skill, but the ultimate goal is to drive clicks, conversions, and revenue. If your mindset is purely aesthetic, this may not be the right fit. If you think about hooks, buyer psychology, value propositions, retention, and conversion while you edit, we want to hear from you.




Your primary responsibility will be transforming raw footage, including UGC, influencer content, product footage, and internal shoots, into scroll-stopping, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.




We do not need cinematic edits for the sake of looking cinematic. We need clear, smart, persuasive short-form videos that capture attention, communicate value, and make people want to click “Buy.”




You will work under the Marketing Manager and collaborate closely with the broader marketing, paid media, social media, influencer, and creative teams.




This is a high-ownership role with significant room for growth. As you demonstrate strong performance, strategic thinking, and leadership, there is an opportunity to grow into senior performance creative, creative strategy, or creative leadership.




Here is the exact type of videos looking for you to make:

https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=ALL&is_targeted_country=false&media_type=all&search_type=page&sort_data[direction]=desc&sort_data[mode]=total_impressions&view_all_page_id=441539569357988 




Your primary mission:

Turn products, offers, and real customer stories into video ads that make people stop scrolling, understand the value of the product, and take action. Every edit you make should serve a business goal.




Your primary focus will be paid advertising on Meta and TikTok, with additional support for organic social content when needed.




What You’ll Do: 

1) Paid Advertising Creative (Primary Focus)

Create vertical video ads for Meta, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
Transform UGC, influencer content, product footage, and internal footage into high-performing paid ads.
Develop multiple hook variations, creative angles, pacing structures, and messaging approaches.
Structure videos using clear problem → solution → outcome frameworks.
Create UGC-style and influencer-style ads that feel authentic while driving action.
Identify and extract the strongest moments from longer footage.
Repurpose and remix existing footage into multiple testable creative variations.
Write and apply clear, compelling, and readable on-screen copy.
Create different versions of ads to test hooks, openings, messaging, pacing, CTAs, and visual approaches.
Optimize creative based on performance data, including CTR, thumb-stop rate, retention, watch time, and conversion performance.
Continuously analyze what is working and use those insights to improve future creative.




2) Creative Strategy & Content Direction 

You will not only edit what you are given. You will also help determine what content should be created next.

Identify creative opportunities based on product benefits, customer pain points, offers, trends, and performance data.
Develop creative concepts and ad angles that can be tested.
Create clear creative briefs and content request documents.
Recommend the types of footage, clips, shots, hooks, and messaging needed from the founder, internal team, or UGC creators.
Suggest improvements to framing, pacing, messaging, storytelling, and visual direction.
Help create repeatable creative frameworks and playbooks for producing high-performing ads.
Contribute ideas for new creative concepts rather than waiting for direction on every project.




3) UGC & Organic Content Support

Paid ads are the primary focus, but you may also support broader short-form content when needed.

Edit short-form product and website videos to improve conversion rate.
Turn influencer and internal footage into organic-style content.
Support TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Add captions, transitions, sound design, motion graphics, and branded elements.
Collaborate with the Social Media Manager on trends, content direction, and creative ideas.
Repurpose existing content across multiple platforms and formats.




4) Speed, Testing & Execution

This is a high-output role.

Work quickly and prioritize execution over perfection.
Produce multiple creative variations within short timelines.
Move quickly from idea → edit → feedback → launch → iteration.
Implement feedback quickly and effectively.
Maintain strong organization, deadlines, and accountability.
Continuously test new hooks, angles, formats, and editing styles.
Be comfortable creating content that may not work and learning from the results.
Maintain a high level of responsiveness and creative output.




5) Organization & Creative Systems 

You will be expected to keep creative workflows organized and scalable.

Maintain organized Google Drive folders and creative assets.
Keep projects, footage, versions, and final files clearly organized.
Build and maintain creative playbooks, SOPs, and repeatable workflows.
Create clear request documents and creative briefs.
Help establish systems that make the creative process faster and easier to scale.




6) Platform & Trend Awareness

Stay current with TikTok, Meta, Instagram, and UGC advertising trends.
Understand how creative performance differs across platforms.
Track cultural and viral hooks relevant to U.S. audiences.
Identify trends that can be adapted to sell products.
Bring trend-aware ideas that are strategically relevant, not simply trends for the sake of following trends.




What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who thinks like both an editor and a marketer.

Has experience editing paid advertisements or high-performing short-form content.
Understands hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, and buyer psychology.
Can create UGC-style ads that feel authentic and persuasive.
Has a KPI-driven mindset and cares about results, not just aesthetics.
Is highly organized and comfortable managing multiple creative projects.
Moves quickly and can produce a high volume of creative.
Is proactive and capable of working independently.
Is comfortable receiving direct feedback and making fast iterations.
Can identify problems in a piece of creative and recommend how to improve it.
Takes ownership of projects from concept through execution.
Thinks like a growth operator, not just an editor.




You take ownership. You move fast. You think about the customer. And you understand that the best creative is creative that performs. 




Must-Have Skills

Experience editing short-form video content and/or paid advertisements.
Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar editing software.
Proven ability to structure short-form content for engagement and conversion.
Ability to identify the strongest moments and hooks from raw footage.
Strong understanding of on-screen copy and messaging.
Understanding of how creative impacts CTR, ROAS, retention, and conversion performance.
Ability to suggest improvements to framing, pacing, storytelling, and creative direction.
Strong communication and organizational skills.
Fluent English.

*Motion graphics and AI video production experience are a plus.

*Tools: Nanabanana pro, adobe premier pro, capcut pro, Higgsfield ai, eleven labs, Runway, motion, figma and HeyGen.




Performance & Accountability

This role will be evaluated based on both creative output and measurable creative impact. Key performance indicators may include:

Click-through rate (CTR)
Thumb-stop and scroll-stop performance
Video retention and watch time
Conversion performance
Testing velocity
Quality and variety of creative iterations
Contribution to ad efficiency and scale
Ability to consistently produce and improve high-performing creative

Your edits are expected to drive results, not simply look good.




Benefits & Growth

Fully remote role, work from anywhere.
Full-time or part-time opportunity.
Flexible working hours with a focus on performance and results.
Performance-based bonuses, with total compensation reaching $1,700+ USD/month.
Fast-growing startup environment.
High level of creative ownership.
Opportunity to work directly with a growing DTC brand.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off and company holidays.
Long-term growth opportunity into senior performance creative, creative strategy, or creative leadership.




How to Apply:

Send us your resume and portfolio to recruiting@topfoxx.com along with examples of short-form video content, paid advertisements, UGC-style videos, or other relevant work.




If you're passionate about using creativity to drive real business results and take action, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
About the job

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

Amazon is seeking Shift Station Manager with the chance to be based in Chihuahua, Chihuahua, MX. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers.

Three Key Areas That You Will Always Focus On Are Safety, Service Quality, Customer Experience, And Productivity Of Your Department. Main Activities Are


 Review the operational forecast and determine productivity requirements for sort operation, manage a team group to meet all building’s goals.
 Support all safety programs to ensure a safe work environment for all associates and Delivery service providers.
 Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives and Lean tools.


Key job responsibilities

You will be part of the Amazon Logistics Team, responsible of the day-to-day management of the delivery station, overseeing the operation that focuses on the delivery of Amazon orders direct to customers.

Leading a team of Process Assistants and Delivery Service Providers in daily management of the delivery station, including meetings, training sessions, assigning job duties, and communicating with DSPs including management representatives and their drivers.

You are responsible for ensuring that you have a safe work place, properly trained people, and that their needs are addressed so they can focus on their jobs.

In addition, one of the most important aspects of your job is to lead change at internet speed… innovation has made us the global company that we are today.

Help in daily operations: Receive, scan, lift and move shipments up to 25 kgs. Each

Route shipments within the AMZL coverage area.

Support and assign job duties to process assistants.

Due to the nature of Amazon’s business, being able to adapt to sudden changes and growth according to operational necessities.

Track & monitor sorting operation and driver’s dispatch.

Continual standing and/or walking an average of 5 miles daily.

Ability to work in construction /distribution environments that may be noisy, unlit, unheated, not air-conditioned.

#AmazonMexico

Basic Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
 2+ years of direct management experience
 2+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
About the job

Company: The Mood Company

Brand: Good Mood Spanish

Employment Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor

Work Arrangement: Remote

Student Level: Adult Learners

About The Mood Company

The Mood Company is an education studio dedicated to building better ways to learn.

Through educational brands such as Good Mood Spanish, we create practical, engaging, and learner-centered programs that help adults build real-world skills with confidence.

We are currently looking for an experienced Spanish tutor to provide high-quality online lessons to adult learners.

About the Role

As a Spanish Tutor, you will teach online Spanish lessons to adult students with different learning goals, language levels, and backgrounds.

Lessons may focus on practical conversation, pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary, travel, workplace communication, or general language development.

This is a part-time independent contractor position. Class opportunities will be offered based on student demand, tutor availability, teaching experience, and teaching style.

Responsibilities
Teach engaging online Spanish lessons to adult learners
Adjust lessons according to each student’s level, goals, and learning style
Explain Spanish grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and cultural context clearly
Encourage students to speak and participate actively during lessons
Prepare appropriate lesson materials and activities when needed
Provide helpful and respectful feedback to students
Maintain professional communication with students and The Mood Company
Attend scheduled lessons on time and notify the company promptly of any scheduling concerns
Follow The Mood Company’s teaching and student-support guidelines
Minimum Qualifications
At least one year of Spanish teaching or tutoring experience
Native or highly proficient Spanish-language ability
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to teach adult learners in a patient, supportive, and professional manner
Reliable internet connection, computer, webcam, and microphone
Comfortable using online teaching and video-conferencing platforms
Ability to work independently as a contractor
Preferred Qualifications
Experience teaching Spanish as a second or foreign language
Experience teaching students from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds
Degree or certificate related to Spanish, linguistics, education, or language teaching
Experience creating lesson plans, worksheets, or digital learning materials
Ability to explain Spanish concepts in English
Experience teaching practical conversation or workplace Spanish
Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is dependable, encouraging, and adaptable.

You should be able to create a comfortable learning environment while maintaining clear lesson structure and professional standards. We are especially interested in tutors who understand that adult learners may have different goals, schedules, and levels of confidence.

Contractor Information
This is a part-time independent contractor position
Tutors are not guaranteed a minimum number of students or teaching hours
Class assignments depend on student enrollment, tutor availability, and program needs
Contractors are responsible for their own equipment, workspace, taxes, and required business expenses
Compensation: [Insert hourly rate or class rate]
Expected availability: [Insert preferred days and hours]
Classes are conducted remotely through [Insert teaching platform]
Application Process

Applicants will be asked to submit:

Full name and contact information
Resume or CV
Summary of Spanish teaching experience
Current availability
Languages spoken
Relevant degrees, certificates, or training
A short introduction explaining their teaching style

Selected applicants may also be asked to complete a short teaching demonstration or submit a sample lesson video.

Submitting an application does not guarantee an interview or teaching assignment. The Mood Company will review each application and contact candidates whose experience and availability match current or upcoming opportunities.

Equal Opportunity

The Mood Company welcomes applicants from diverse professional, cultural, and educational backgrounds. Hiring decisions are based on qualifications, teaching ability, professionalism, availability, and program needs.

description:
About the job

✨ Tu talento impulsa nuestro futuro

Getnet es una empresa global de tecnología especializada en soluciones de pago para el comercio. Fundada en Brasil y con presencia en América Latina y la Península Ibérica, apoyamos a más de 1,3 millones de comercios con servicios completos: desde datáfonos hasta soluciones de e-commerce.

Formamos parte de PagoNxt, la fintech global del Grupo Santander, y operamos como un hub de adquirencia con fuerte presencia en España, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina y Uruguay.

Nuestra misión es clara: simplificar los pagos con innovación, seguridad y escala, ayudando a negocios de todos los tamaños a crecer con agilidad.

Ofrecemos una plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevención de fraudes, adquirencia, conciliación y servicios financieros — todo en un solo ecosistema, para que nuestros clientes puedan enfocarse en hacer crecer su negocio.

Ser parte de Getnet es unirse a una empresa que combina la innovación de una fintech con la solidez de un banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey. 

Esto significa que tendrás la oportunidad de construir soluciones con impacto, crecer con oportunidades reales de desarrollo y prosperar en una cultura que valora el bienestar, la inclusión y la claridad.

description:
About the job

Who we are:

Four years ago, Dragonfruit set out to bring together some of the most talented visual storytellers, viral video strategists, and big-name clients, to change the way we create and consume on YouTube.




The result has been bigger than we could have imagined, having generated over a billion organic views and hundreds of millions of subscribers for creators like MrBeast, Ali Abdaal, Neil Patel, Chris Williamson, Codie Sanchez, and orgs like Y Combinator, e.l.f beauty, WHOOP, ClickUp, Linktree, Center for Humane Technology & more.




Unlike other social media agencies or YouTube businesses, Dragonfruit refuses to celebrate a “creator economy” that trades viewers’ time and attention for rapid-fire dopamine entertainment.




Instead, we want to lead a global movement to make YouTube a more valuable and educational place for all people; where views and subscribers are never an end in and of themselves, but rather a means of increasing human flourishing; where viral-educational YouTube channels not only bolster awareness and impact for our client's brands, but also create genuine value in viewers’ lives.




Dragonfruit's Mission

Dragonfruit exists to help the world’s most important ideas travel farther. We partner with experts, educators, scientists, founders, and creators to turn deep knowledge into media people actually want to watch, share, and act on. In a world where attention is often optimized for noise, we’re building a company that rewards clarity, substance, and human impact — combining creative judgment, production craft, and AI-powered systems to help better information reach more people. Our mission is to build the creative infrastructure for a healthier, more thoughtful internet.




The Role

As a YouTube Producer at Dragonfruit, your strength is operational excellence. You will own the integrity of our production operating system. That includes maintaining task hygiene in trhoughout our Production System, enforcing documentation standards, auditing workflows for breakdowns, and continuously improving throughput, clarity, and predictability.




This is a systems-first production role. While you will collaborate with Creative Directors, your primary responsibility is designing, maintaining, and optimizing production workflows across multiple accounts. This role is 10–20% creative alignment and 80–90% operational execution, systems thinking, and technical project management.




Day-to-day, you’ll own the production process across 3-5 client accounts and manage 400+ videos in active production at once. That means allocating editors, anticipating bottlenecks and acting as a trusted partner to clients—guiding timelines, deliverables, and approvals while communicating with empathy, clarity, and authority.




This role is about powering the heartbeat of the most influential YouTube channels in the world. Our clients reach tens of millions of viewers every month, shaping conversations in business, personal & professional development, health & wellness, and beyond. As a Producer, you’re not just managing deadlines—you’re ensuring the ideas that matter most get delivered to the world at scale.




In practice, that makes you one of the most pivotal players in Dragonfruit’s journey to become the most prestigious YouTube agency on the planet. Your work will fuel the growth of channels that are redefining what YouTube can be.




What you can expect:

An exciting startup culture – work cross-functionally, wear several hats, and occasionally work long hours, during evenings, and/or weekends. We are a hungry and ambitious group of people trying to accomplish something large and challenging and we’re looking for folks who are enthusiastic and willing to do what is required to reach their goals
Personal growth – use Dragonfruit’s culture of excellence as an incubator to improve your professional skills, learn new mental models, sharpen your critical thinking, and increase productivity
Be a key player in a fast-growing company – help to identify blind spots in our service offering and work collaboratively with the team to improve systems/processes
Earn more – take advantage of regular performance-based raises, generous referral and sales commissions, & more.
Time zone overlap – while we're fully remote and flexible on where your hours fall, this is a client-facing role, so you'll need consistent daily overlap with U.S. business hours to stay responsive to clients.




Skills and Qualifications:

2+ years of experience as a Producer, Production Manager, or Project Manager in a creative, media, or agency setting
Proven ability to manage complex, high-volume production pipelines across multiple client accounts simultaneously without compromising on quality or deadlines
Exceptional operator mindset – you’re detail-oriented, highly organized, and proactive in spotting and solving problems before they escalate
Resource allocation and capacity planning expertise – you know how to assign editors effectively based on strengths, bandwidth, and deadlines
Confident communicator with clients – You can empathetically set boundaries, communicate trade-offs, and frame delays in a way that maintains trust.




Systems & Technical Competency (required)

Advanced fluency in project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, etc.) — including automations, dashboards, dependencies, and workflow design.
Ability to design and improve repeatable workflows — you think in systems, not tasks.
Experience managing 100+ concurrent deliverables at once without losing visibility.
Comfortable analyzing data to inform decisions (capacity planning, editor allocation, delivery timelines).
Clear documentation habits — you leave processes better documented than you found them




This Role Is Not For You If:

You prefer unstructured creative environments without standardized workflows.
You dislike working inside project management systems.
You struggle with documentation, process discipline, or technical tools.
You prefer ideation over execution




Perks:

Work from anywhere (we're 100% remote)Competitive Healthcare Coverage (medical, dental, vision)
Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements
Unlimited reimbursements on book purchases (we like to read 🙂)
Paid volunteering: 1 day dedicated to supporting a cause of your choice
Work directly with some of the largest creators/brands on the planet
Work for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact




If you're ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in the future of YouTube, apply today!
